value.summary: Added edge-case tests to tests/slug.test.mjs: slug("") === "" (pipeline is a no-op and hyphen trim leaves empty), slug("Café") === "cafe" (NFKD + diacritic stripping), and slug("日本語") === "" (non-ASCII collapses to a hyphen that the final trim removes). The existing simple test is untouched and lib/ is unchanged. Ran the suite with node --test; all tests pass. Satisfied: empty-string and unicode coverage added, lib untouched.
